children: Healthcare companies reported broadly positive Q3 results last week, with every S&P 500 healthcare stock that posted results showing Y/Y topline growth, although earnings growth was less consistent.
Of the 23 companies reporting, 22 firms (96%) exceeded EPS expectations, while 1 fell short. Notably, 16 firms (70%) posted Y/Y earnings growth.
Of the 23 companies reporting, 21 firms (91%) exceeded revenue expectations, while 2 fell below analyst estimates. Notably, all 23 firms (100%) posted Y/Y revenue growth.
Let’s take a look at some of the healthcare companies that reported earnings this week:

reported Q3 revenue of $17.40B, up 10.3% Y/Y, beating the $17.35B consensus. Adjusted EPS of $3.82 beat the $3.77 estimate. Growth was driven by strong sales of Skyrizi and Rinvoq, which rose 22.7% and 23.9%, respectively. The company raised its FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $13.95–$13.99 from $13.76–$13.96.

reported Q3 revenue of $24.40B, up 39% Y/Y, beating the $22.42B consensus. Adjusted EPS of $7.48 beat the $5.60 estimate. Growth was driven by strong demand for Mounjaro and Zepbound. The company raised its FY2026 revenue outlook to $91B–$92B.

reported Q3 revenue of $13.07B, up 7% Y/Y, beating consensus, while adjusted EPS of $1.35 topped the $1.09 estimate. Growth was driven by its Growth Portfolio, particularly Eliquis, which generated $4.69B in sales, up 25% Y/Y. The company raised its FY2026 revenue outlook but lowered its adjusted EPS forecast to $6.35–$6.55.

reported Q3 revenue of $8.30B, up 7% Y/Y, beating the $7.79B consensus. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.55 beat the $2.17 estimate. HIV medicines drove growth, with Biktarvy sales rising 10% to $4.1B. Trodelvy sales increased 42% to $506M. Gilead raised its FY2026 product sales outlook to $31B–$31.3B.

reported Q3 revenue of $5.12B, up 36% Y/Y, beating the $4.56B consensus. Adjusted EPS of $20.07 beat the $16.25 estimate. Growth was driven by strong sales of Dupixent (up 35%), Eylea HD (up 62%) and Libtayo (up 51%).

reported Q3 revenue of $2.8B, up 11% Y/Y, beating the $2.63B consensus. Non-GAAP EPS of $2.62 topped the $1.98 estimate. Growth Portfolio revenue surged 49% to $1.26B, while Spinraza sales rose 23% to $461M. The company raised the lower end of its FY2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $12.20.

reported Q3 revenue of $1.13B, up 4.2% Y/Y. GAAP diluted EPS was $1.43 versus $0.98 a year earlier. Clinical demand and NovaSeq X placements supported growth. The company raised its FY2026 revenue outlook to $4.64B–$4.66B and non-GAAP EPS outlook to $5.40–$5.45.
For the upcoming week, investors will continue to watch healthcare earnings, including reports from Amgen
